# Practise any topic in small steps

Exercise mode lets you turn any topic you want to get better at into a short, guided practice session, not just something to read about. You pick the topic, and the assistant breaks it into small steps you work through and tick off yourself.

## Contents

- [What it does for you](#what-it-does-for-you)
- [How it works](#how-it-works)
- [Good to know](#good-to-know)
- [Words used here](#words-used-here)

## What it does for you

- Asks why you want to learn it, how experienced you are, and how much time you have, plus a couple of quick questions to skip what you already know.
- Sets a clear goal stated as something you can do, along with how that will be checked at the end.
- Breaks the goal into five to nine short steps, each about ten to twenty-five minutes, each with a purpose and a clear sign of when it is done.
- Coaches you with hints instead of answers, only giving the solution if you ask after trying.
- Ends with a recall check, done without notes, and remembers what you struggled with for next time.

## How it works

1. You tell the assistant the topic you want to practise.
2. It asks a few questions about your goal, level and time, plus some quick checks on what you already know.
3. It builds a goal and a set of small steps and saves them.
4. The steps show up in the Exercises tab, where you can see the current step and your progress.
5. You tick off steps as you finish them, skip ones you don't need, add notes, or split a step into smaller ones.
6. At the end, you do a short recall check, and any weak points are kept for next time.

## Good to know

- Exercises belong to you, not to any particular project. The same list shows up wherever you work.
- They stay only on the device you are using and are not shared between machines.
- Reading-only steps make up at most a third of each exercise. Every exercise includes at least one hands-on step and a closing recall.
- A step you skip is kept, not removed, so your history of what you chose to skip is preserved.

## Words used here

- Exercise: a topic you are practising, made up of a goal and a set of small steps you tick off.
- Step: one small piece of an exercise, such as learning something, trying an example, or doing a recall check.
